# Roadmap: Business Analyst

## Role overview

Gathers business requirements and translates them for developers.

## Prerequisites

- None. Start with Stage 1.

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [Agile & Scrum](../topics/agile.md)
- [ ] [SQL](../topics/database-sql.md)

## Also needed

BABOK, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence, Visio, Excel

## Where it leads

Grow: Product Owner (PO), Product Manager (PM) · Lead: Project Manager · Pivot: Data Analyst, AI Product Manager, Pre-Sales / Solutions Consultant
